testcase.name: Recipients receive a prefix of the selection sequence: a saturated viewer gets the essential points first
Thinning does not read or copy coordinates: the frame of a delivery is the M5 frame, and selections index into it
Selection formula: floorMod(ordinal, g) + floor(j n / m) with g = ceil(n / m), strictly increasing, for extreme ordinals
G6 coverage: any g consecutive frame ordinals together select every point; selected points are spread with gaps <= g
Largest remainder: floor shares, then one point each to the largest (r n_b) mod T, ties to the earlier layer
G7: essential layers complete before standard, standard before decorative, whatever the layer order
